item.title: United Airlines reports widespread systems outage
item.description:
United Airlines announced that it is experiencing a "widespread systems outage" and is working to resolve the issue as quickly as possible.
"We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience. We're aware of the widespread system outage, and our teams are working hard to get things back up and running as soon as possible. We appreciate your patience while we work through this," the airline said.

item.title: Attempted terrorist attack reported near Jericho
item.description:
The IDF announced that it received a report of an attempted terrorist attack in the Jericho area.
IDF forces were dispatched to the scene and set up roadblocks in the area. The circumstances of the incident are under investigation.

item.title: Customers at major US banks report glitches
item.description:
Customers at American banks, including Chase, Bank of America, Wells Fargo, US Bank, JPMorgan and Truist, are reporting problems with online services. According to a US report, the complaints include difficulties viewing account activity and making transfers and payments.
The report is based on user complaints on the Downdetector website. At this stage, the extent of the outages and their cause are unclear, and it is not known if they are related.

item.title: Customers report outages at major US banks
item.description:
Customers at major US banks, including Chase, Bank of America, Wells Fargo, U.S. Bank, J.P. Morgan and Truist, are reporting problems with online banking services, including viewing transactions, transferring money and making payments.
The reports are based on user complaints tracked by Downdetector. The cause and extent of the disruptions remain unclear, and it is not yet known whether they are connected.
